message: 'Luck of the Gambler: Defense/Endurance' is the only 'Luck_of_the_Gambler' piece in 'Scrapper_Defense.Shield_Defense.Grant_Cover'; set bonuses need at least 2 pieces of one set in the same power, so this piece adds no set bonus (its own enhancement value, and any proc it carries, still apply)
fix: slot a second 'Luck_of_the_Gambler' piece in this power, use a piece carrying a global, or confirm the lone piece is a deliberate proc carrier or mule
